title: Mary Roy Precedent: Christian Daughter Omitted
description: Daughter Mary Chacko excluded from 1996 partition deed
legal_citation: Mary Roy v. State of Kerala (1986 AIR 1011)
remedial_action: Obtain registered release deed from Mary Chacko

title: Ghost Mortgage Detected in EC
description: Doc 3012/2022 shows active mortgage with Federal Bank
legal_citation: Transfer of Property Act Sec 58 / Sec 17 Registration Act
remedial_action: Demand Bank Loan Clearance & Original Title Deeds

title: Extent Inflation: Nemo Dat Quod Non Habet
description: Seller conveyed 11.0 cents but parent deed 890/1996 only granted 10.0 cents
legal_citation: Transfer of Property Act Sec 7 & 8
remedial_action: Verify actual surveyed boundary extent

title: Reserved Easement / Servitude in Deed #2740/2017
description: Deed 2740/2017 (2017) reserves: '4 meter wide southern motorable pathway / നടപ്പുവഴി അവകാശം'. This creates an encumbrance running with the land.
legal_citation: Indian Easements Act, 1882 (Section 4 & Section 13 - Easements of Necessity)
remedial_action: Conduct on-site physical inspection to locate '4 meter wide southern motorable pathway / നടപ്പുവഴി അവകാശം'. Ensure future building plan/compound wall will not obstruct this reserved pathway or water access.

title: Minor's Share Sold Without Court Permission in Deed #3039/2015
description: Deed 3039/2015 (2015) involved alienation of property belonging to a minor by a natural/de-facto guardian without prior sanction of the District Court.
legal_citation: Section 8(2), Hindu Minority and Guardianship Act, 1956 / Guardians and Wards Act, 1890
remedial_action: Verify if the minor has attained majority (>18 years). If within 3 years of attaining majority, the transfer is legally voidable. Obtain a registered ratification deed from the former minor.

title: Excluded Legal Heirs in Bhagapathram (Partition Deed) #1519/2005
description: Deed 1519/2005 omitted legal heirs (Sister / Female Co-heir (Mary Roy Exclusion)) from execution. Female heirs have equal entitlement to intestate parental property.
legal_citation: Indian Succession Act, 1925 & Supreme Court judgment in Mary Roy v. State of Kerala (1986)
remedial_action: Require all omitted heirs (Sister / Female Co-heir (Mary Roy Exclusion)) or their surviving legal representatives to execute a registered Release Deed (Ozhivumuri) or join as confirming parties in the proposed sale deed.

title: Undisclosed Transaction Found in EC: Doc #7259/2020
description: The SRO Encumbrance Certificate logs a registered entry (Doc #7259/2020, Nature: Simple Mortgage / ഈട് ബാധ്യത - Kerala State Co-operative Bank (₹15,00,000)) that was NOT provided in the seller's prior deeds dossier. Possible mortgage, attachment, or partial sale.
legal_citation: Indian Registration Act, 1908 (Section 17 & Section 51)
remedial_action: Apply for a certified copy of Doc #7259/2020 from the Sub-Registrar Office immediately. Do not pay any advance until this registered document is inspected and cleared.
